We are the Veterinary Department of RWD Life Science Co. LTD.  Our mission is to provide veterinarians with reliable, innovative, and high-quality tools to ensure the best possible outcomes for their patients.  Additionally, our Vet Academy, a continuing education (CE) platform for veterinarians, empowers professionals worldwide through various workshops, webinars, and seminars.
